title: save_decision_proposal input
description: Records a decision for acceptance: what, why, the options weighed and the outcome proposed. The decision is always Proposed. The decider is resolved from the decision rights (the accountable holder in C31) and the caller cannot set it. No input carries a status. Configuration and gate policy decisions use propose_configuration_change instead, and the engine refuses them here.

decisionId.description: Edit this decision while it is Proposed. Leave out to record a new one.

subjectKind.description: The kind of record the decision is about. data-use takes a data-use decision (one per use) or a data-retention decision (a use that writes, at retirement); data-mapping takes a data-use decision about a copy. Owner changes of a data domain or location start with propose_owner_change.

subjectId.description: The ID of the subject row.

context.description: The situation and the forces at play.

optionsConsidered.description: The options weighed and why each was not chosen.

proposedOutcomeKey.description: The outcome proposed. It takes effect only when the decision is accepted through people's answers on the decision page.

tierKey.description: For a tier decision: the tier it sets once accepted, when a person raises or lowers the computed tier. Leave out to confirm the tier the latest answers computed.

autonomyLevelKey.description: For an autonomy level decision: the level from the autonomy-level list it stores once accepted with outcome agree.

supersedesDecisionId.description: An accepted decision this one replaces, once accepted.

amendsDecisionId.description: An accepted decision this one amends, once accepted.

slideBackSignalKey.description: The slide-back signal this decision acts on (playbook chapter 17; get_measures signals). The Measures page lists the decisions each signal led to.

evidence.description: Links to proof held elsewhere. Each becomes an Evidence Link (O20).

exception.description: Required for an exception decision, and only there: the standard it departs from and the date it is reviewed again (document 23, P04 step 6).

standard.description: The standard, guideline or rule the exception departs from, in plain words.

reviewOn.description: The date the exception is reviewed again: today or later.

examples.statement: Store visit photos in the team site library, not in the app.
examples.context: Photos grow fast and the app storage is small.

optionsConsidered.whyNot: Storage runs out within a year.

examples.reason: The library is already backed up and searchable.
